newsitem.title: USA: ATHLETICS-JOHNSON AGREES $12 MILLION DEAL WITH NIKE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-JOHNSON AGREES $12 MILLION DEAL WITH NIKE.

text.p: Double Olympic champion Michael Johnson has signed a deal with shoe company Nike worth at least $12 million, his agent said on Friday.

In a statement, Brad Hunt said the six-year extension to Johnson's current contract also included royalties from a special training shoe and performance incentives "potentially worth additional millions".
"This agreement represents the most profound commitment a track athlete has ever received from a corporate endorsement," Hunt said.
Last year Johnson became the first man to win the Olympic 200 and 400 metres double, breaking his own world record in the 200.
The 29-year-old Texan meets Canada's Olympic 100 gold medallist Donovan Bailey over 150 metres in a million dollar race in Toronto on June 1.
